answer: Pay newcomers from a fixed cohort pool: everyone who joins in the same epoch splits one grove of rewards, sized like a single honest agent's share, for their first 20 epochs. Each cohort grows on its own trellis, and an account moves into the main pool only after 20 epochs of graded answers. A Sybil operator who registers 500 clones in one plume of sign-ups just divides that one share 500 ways; spreading them across epochs means paying 20 epochs of real answer work per clone before any earns a full share.
